en.bdb: The true Guru is the knowing god

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਾਗਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਸਿਵਰਾਤੀ ਜਾਤੀ ਮੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: sidh saadhik mil jaagadhe kar sivaraatee jaatee melaa|

en.bdb: The siddhs and other performer of austerities by remaining awake celebrate the Sivaratri fair.

verses.gurmukhi: ਮਹਾਦੇਉ ਅਉਧੂਤੁ ਹੈ ਕਵਲਾਸਣਿ ਆਸਣਿ ਰਸਕੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: mahaadheau aaudhoot hai kavalaasan aasan rasakelaa|

en.bdb: Mahadev is a recluse and Brahma is absorbed in the delight of the seat of lotus.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੋਰਖੁ ਜੋਗੀ ਜਾਗਦਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਮਾਛਿੰਦ੍ਰ ਧਰੀ ਸੁ ਧਰੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: gorakh jogee jaagadhaa gur maachhi(n)dhr dharee su dharelaa|

en.bdb: That Gorakh the yogi is also awake whose teacher Machhendr had kept a beautiful concubine.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਜਾਗਿ ਜਗਾਇਦਾ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: satigur jaag jagaidhaa saadhasa(n)gat mil a(n)mirat velaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is awake and he in the holy congregation in ambrosial hours makes others also awake (from the sleep of infatuation).

verses.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈਅਨੁ ਅਨਹਦ ਸਬਦ ਪਿਰਮ ਰਸਖੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: nij ghar taaRee laieean anahadh sabadh piram rasakhelaa|

en.bdb: In the holy congregation, theji-vs concentrate upon their self and remain absorbed in the loving delight of the unstruck word.

verses.gurmukhi: ਆਦਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਆਦੇਸ ਹੈ ਅਲਖ ਨਿਰੰਜਨ ਨੇਹੁ ਨ ਵੇਲਾ।
verses.translit_en: aadh purakh aadhes hai alakh nira(n)jan neh na velaa|

en.bdb: I salute the primal person, the Guru whose love and affection for the imperceptible Lord is ever fresh.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੇਲੇ ਤੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਤੇ ਚੇਲਾ ॥੧੭॥
verses.translit_en: chele te gur gur te chelaa ||17||

en.bdb: From disciple, the devotee becomes Guru and the Guru becomes disciple.
